name: print-social-post-purple-serif-lorem-starburst
title: Purple/pink post with serif headline and starburst accent
whatItIs: A square social post on a pink background, with a rounded purple content panel holding a large serif/script mixed headline, body copy, and social icons, accented by an orange starburst shape.
whatItMeans: Mixing a classic serif word with a casual script word in one headline signals a brand voice that's both established and approachable, reinforced by the playful starburst accent.
techniques: combine two contrasting type styles (serif + script) within one headline for personality
use a single bold starburst shape as an eye-catching accent rather than multiple small icons
round all panel corners generously for a soft, friendly feel
bestFor: lifestyle or wellness brand social posts

vocabulary.definition: the practice of combining two typefaces with contrasting qualities to add visual interest and hierarchy
